features.title: My work overview
features.userOutcome: Aggregate explicit selected assigned issues, authored PRs and review requests with per-source completeness.
features.boundaryAcceptance: The default scope never expands to every private organization repository.
features.dataSource: canonical allowlisted GitHub reads or verified Action publications
features.privacy: session-first-private-data; no telemetry; redacted exports; explicit persistence only for authored personal state
features.activation: eligibility before mount; user gesture for reads beyond the current page, drafts, writes and optional grants
features.coexistence: omit equivalent native control; explain loaded scope; preserve native content, drafts, checks and recovery
features.accessibility: keyboard/focus, screen reader, 200% zoom/320 CSS px, themes, reduced motion; complete en/es/fr/pt

tests.scenario: Given the eligible local control center and verified input, choosing my work overview produces this observable result: Aggregate explicit selected assigned issues, authored PRs and review requests with per-source completeness.
For my work overview, exercise the concrete boundary: The default scope never expands to every private organization repository.
A denied, truncated or expired source for my work overview shows its exact unavailable/partial reason instead of a zero or success.
Changing the selected repository/account/revision while my work overview is loading prevents the late result from rendering.
